review_note: Source says adverse Sun conditions can make reckless/destructive Pojun become entrenched and affect later periods; this is explicit acquired-state persistence beyond a memoryless natal+input reaction.

Source says fallen Sun is unfavorable to afflicted Jumen and fails to resolve its dark/obscuring quality; supports QI-14 visibility/obscuration as a system-context state.
Source explicitly says exalted Sun can make entrepreneurial Tianxiang over-act and fail; high activation is not monotonically favorable.
Source says integrated Tianliang is better able to use Liansha change but still must avoid heavy malefic/Ji; this is mode-environment compatibility plus a risk gate.

Source says auspicious Tiantong can partially ease harsh Liansha and still permit upward development, though resistance remains; buffering is a derived system response.
Source says Wupo in a year can break through under auspicious transformations but change is frustrated under malefic/Ji/punishment; explicit time-point gate.

Source says Taiyin Hua-Ji harms both modes, with short-willed Tiantong more likely to retreat; pressure response and persistence loss should be separated.

Source says early enjoyment can form a short-willed/empty structure that Qisha later exposes or deepens; it explicitly treats earlier periods as shaping a later response substrate.
Source says non-empty/non-exposed Tianfu is favorable to adaptable Wupo and can support entrepreneurship; compatibility with a stable resource environment.
Source says Ji-Yue with Hua-Ji is adverse to Wupo and can lead to wrong decisions, especially when trying to reverse the situation; decision-error projection.

Source says boom-bust ZiTan/Fire-Ring or Ji conditions can deepen timid Tianfu's timid nature, explicitly describing acquired reinforcement across periods.
Source says Jumen is generally disliked by Tianfu: modest mode stagnates while timid mode becomes indecisive; output paths differ by mode.

Source says good Wupo lets modest Tianfu reform with the tide; constructive change output.

Source says non-affective Zixiang is relatively compatible with Tianliang and can be recognized/expressed; downstream recognition opportunity.
Source says natal Pojun Hua-Lu is not monotonically favorable: affective Zixiang can over-activate change and be frustrated, while non-affective mode becomes decisive.
Source says Qisha change may look favorable for floating Tianliang yet hide crisis; this is mode-dependent reliability of a downstream opportunity.

Source says authority Qisha likes good Pojun and experiences good-quality transformation; downstream change output.
